about: Designer notes for every MagickHome catalogue category. 'prompt_note', 'combinations' and 'width_notes' are shown to Qwen next to each option it can choose. status: offered = Qwen can choose it, auto = the solver adds it, not_yet = the generator does not use it yet. confirm = true marks notes a MagickHome designer should check.

Base Unit.purpose: General base storage under the counter.
Base Unit.choose_when: Drawer versions next to the hob for utensils and pans; shutter versions for bulk storage, cleaning items and bins.
Base Unit.avoid: Many narrow single-shutter units in one run.

combinations.Four Drawer: cutlery, ladles, small tools - best right beside the hob
combinations.Double Drawer: deep drawers for pans, kadai and plates - hob wall
combinations.Drawer with Double Shutter: top cutlery drawer + shelf below - all-round storage
combinations.Drawer with Single Shutter: top drawer + narrow shelf - fill unit
combinations.Double Shutter: bulk storage, bins, cleaning items - the solver uses these to fill runs

Base Sink Unit.purpose: Carcass under the sink bowl with room for pipes, waste bin and cleaning items.
Base Sink Unit.choose_when: Always one per kitchen, centred under the window.
Base Sink Unit.avoid: Placing it on a wall without the window when a usable window wall exists.

combinations.Sink Double Drawer: drawers cut around the plumbing - premium

width_notes.800: small kitchens (window wall under 2400 mm free)
width_notes.900: standard single-bowl sink - right for most kitchens
width_notes.1200: large or double bowl - only with 3600+ mm free

Base Hob Unit.purpose: Unit under the built-in hob; the chimney hangs above it.
Base Hob Unit.choose_when: Always one per kitchen, on a solid wall. Drawer versions are the designer default.
Base Hob Unit.avoid: Shutter versions (pans are hard to reach); placing it under a window or beside a door.

combinations.Triple Drawer - A: 3 drawers: ladles, pans, pressure cookers - best choice
combinations.Hob Double Shutter: shelf behind shutters - budget, pans hard to reach
combinations.Hob Triple Drawer With Flap Down: 3 drawers with a flap-down top front
combinations.Hob Double Drawer With Flap Down A: 2 drawers with a flap-down top front
combinations.Hob Double Drawer With Flap Down B: 2 drawers with a flap-down top front
combinations.Hob Double Shutter With Flap Down: shutters with a flap-down top front
combinations.Hob Single Shutter With Flap Down: single shutter with a flap-down top front

width_notes.750: compact - hob wall under 2400 mm free

Base Spice Pull Out.purpose: Tall narrow pull-out for masalas, oils and sauces.
Base Spice Pull Out.avoid: Placing it away from the hob.
Base Spice Pull Out.prompt_note: masalas and oils, right beside the hob

Base Cylinder Unit.purpose: Houses the LPG cylinder; 800 mm high, floor-standing for easy rolling.
Base Cylinder Unit.choose_when: Kitchens on LPG with room beside the hob (hob wall 2700+ mm free).
Base Cylinder Unit.avoid: Kitchens with piped gas; tight hob walls.
Base Cylinder Unit.prompt_note: LPG cylinder, beside the hob (needs a long hob wall)

Base Grain Trolley.purpose: Pull-out bins for atta, rice and dal.
Base Grain Trolley.choose_when: Storage zone, beside a tall unit or at the end of a run.
Base Grain Trolley.prompt_note: atta, rice, dal bins - storage zone

combinations.Grain Trolley With 1 Internal Drawer: bins + an inner drawer behind one front

Base Wicker Basket Unit.purpose: Ventilated wicker baskets for onions, potatoes and vegetables.
Base Wicker Basket Unit.choose_when: Near the sink (wash, then cut) or in the storage zone.
Base Wicker Basket Unit.prompt_note: vegetables, onions, potatoes - near the sink

Base Low Height Unit.choose_when: Under a low window sill or a raised appliance (to confirm).
Base Low Height Unit.avoid: Regular counter runs (it is not counter height).

Base Open Unit.choose_when: At an open end of a run for cookbooks or display.
Base Open Unit.prompt_note: open shelf at a run end

Blind corner unit - L.purpose: Standard L/U corner base unit (1050-1250 mm); one side is blind behind the perpendicular run.
Blind corner unit - L.choose_when: Every corner where two base runs meet. L or R follows which end of the wall the corner is at.
Blind corner unit - L.prompt_note: corner base unit (added by the solver)

Blind corner unit - R.choose_when: Corner at the start of the wall.
Blind corner unit - R.prompt_note: corner base unit (added by the solver)

Base L corner unit.purpose: 960 x 960 L-shaped corner cabinet with full access from the front.
Base L corner unit.choose_when: Both walls can give 960 mm at the corner and the customer wants easier corner access.
Base L corner unit.avoid: Tight corners near doors or windows.

Blind Corner Sink Unit.purpose: Sink unit that sits in the corner.
Blind Corner Sink Unit.choose_when: The window is right at a corner, so the sink must sit in the corner.

Blind Corner Sink Unit w/o bottom.purpose: Corner sink unit without a bottom panel (800 mm high, floor standing).
Blind Corner Sink Unit w/o bottom.choose_when: Corner sink where the plumbing comes through the floor.

Blind corner cylinder unit w/o bottom -.purpose: LPG cylinder stored in the blind corner.
Blind corner cylinder unit w/o bottom -.choose_when: The hob is near a corner and the hob wall has no room for a separate cylinder unit.
As the L version, corner at the start of the wall.

Wall Unit.purpose: Wall cabinets above the counter for daily dishes, glasses and dry stock.
Wall Unit.choose_when: Above every base run except the window and the chimney.
Wall Unit.avoid: Many narrow units; wall units over the window or chimney.

Wall Aquaguard Unit.purpose: Wall cabinet that houses the water purifier.
Wall Aquaguard Unit.choose_when: When the household uses a wall-mounted purifier (most Indian homes): on the sink wall right beside the window (water inlet and power near the sink). Not needed with an under-sink RO.
Wall Aquaguard Unit.avoid: Far from the sink; above the hob.
Wall Aquaguard Unit.prompt_note: houses the water purifier - beside the sink window

Wall Glass Unit.purpose: Glass-front wall cabinet to display crockery.
Wall Glass Unit.choose_when: One unit to finish a run or frame the window; lightens a long row of solid doors.
Wall Glass Unit.avoid: More than one or two; above the hob (grease).
Wall Glass Unit.prompt_note: glass display - one unit at the end of a run

Wall Shaker Glass Unit.choose_when: Shaker kitchens: one unit to finish a run.
Wall Shaker Glass Unit.prompt_note: glass display - one unit at the end of a run

Wall Lift Up Unit.purpose: Top-hinged or bi-fold doors that lift up, so no door swings at head height.
Wall Lift Up Unit.choose_when: Narrow kitchens; short 300-450 mm units above the chimney or a tall appliance.
Wall Lift Up Unit.avoid: Users who cannot reach the raised door.
Wall Lift Up Unit.prompt_note: lift-up doors, no door at head height

Wall Open Unit.purpose: Open wall shelves for jars and cookbooks.
Wall Open Unit.choose_when: At run ends as a style accent.

Wall Microwave Open Unit.purpose: 430 mm deep open box for a microwave at wall level.
Wall Microwave Open Unit.choose_when: No tall microwave unit, and the counter must stay free.
Wall Microwave Open Unit.avoid: Placing it too high to lift hot food safely.

Wall Spice Rack Unit.purpose: Open spice rack (250 mm high, 200 mm deep) on the backsplash.
Wall Spice Rack Unit.choose_when: Beside the hob, below the wall cabinets.

Open Horizontal Shelf.choose_when: Above the counter or around the window as an accent.

Wall Tambour Unit.purpose: Roller-shutter appliance garage standing on the counter (1200-1500 mm high).
Wall Tambour Unit.choose_when: Hide the mixer, toaster and kettle on a long counter.

Wall Chamfered Open Cabinets.purpose: 300 mm open end unit with a chamfered side.
Wall Chamfered Open Cabinets.choose_when: To soften the open end of a wall-cabinet run.

Wall L Corner.choose_when: Every wall-cabinet corner with enough room.
Wall L Corner.avoid: Regular wall units in a corner.
Wall L Corner.prompt_note: corner wall cabinet (added by the solver)

Wall Open L Corner.choose_when: Open corner as a display accent.

Tall Unit.purpose: Pantry, crockery or broom cupboard from floor to wall-cabinet top.
Tall Unit.choose_when: At the end of a run near the entrance.
Tall Unit.avoid: In front of a window; right beside the hob; in the middle of a counter run.
Tall Unit.prompt_note: pantry - end of a run near the entrance

Tall Built-In Oven.purpose: Oven at chest height with storage above and below.
Tall Built-In Oven.choose_when: Families who bake; near the cooking zone but not beside the hob.

Tall Built-In Microwave.purpose: Microwave at chest height with storage.
Tall Built-In Microwave.choose_when: Daily reheating; keeps the counter free.
Tall Built-In Microwave.prompt_note: built-in microwave at chest height, frees the counter

Tall Built-In Oven & Micro.purpose: Oven and microwave stacked in one tall unit.
Tall Built-In Oven & Micro.choose_when: Families who both bake and reheat, in a medium or large kitchen.

Tall Built-In Wicker Basket.choose_when: Large vegetable or packet storage near the entrance.

Tall Glass Unit.choose_when: Open kitchens facing the dining area.

Loft - Modular.purpose: Storage above the wall cabinets up to the ceiling for rarely used items.
Loft - Modular.choose_when: Walls tall enough (2.658 m+) and the customer wants lofts.
Loft - Modular.prompt_note: loft above wall cabinets (added by the solver)

Loft - Frame with Shutter.purpose: Loft built as a frame with shutters (site-built look).
Loft - Frame with Shutter.avoid: Mixing with modular lofts on one wall.

Loft - L Corner - Modular.purpose: Loft corner above a Wall L Corner.
Loft - L Corner - Modular.choose_when: Loft corners above a Wall L Corner.
